title: Find the roots
text: $$t^2-2t-3=\left(t-3\right) \left(t+1\right)$$ is $$0$$ at $$t=-1$$ and $$t=3$$. It is negative on $$(-1,3)$$ and positive elsewhere.

title: Evaluate
text: Integrate $$t^2-2t-3$$ on [-2,-1] $$\frac{7}{3}$$, its negative on [-1,3] $$\frac{32}{3}$$, and itself on [3,4] $$\frac{7}{3}$$. The total is $$\frac{46}{3}$$.
